task: Independently reconsider exactly these five unresolved contexts. Do not regenerate corpus. No parser/evaluator/policy/model calls or other-source reads.
execution_contract: Only EXECUTABLE and EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE permit execution. AMBIGUOUS means intended field/value requirement cannot be uniquely resolved; INCOMPLETE means a mandatory operand is unfinished; known conflicts are CONTRADICTORY; unsupported strict fields are UNSUPPORTED.
label_rules: Do not assume contextual uncertainty automatically makes explicit search filters ambiguous. Distinguish anecdotal uncertainty from a mandatory unresolved condition.
Strict title requires explicit titled/called/named; author requires structural author evidence or explicit mandatory authorship request.
A book can have multiple authors. Different author/title strings alone do not prove a contradiction.
Do not assume author-title mapping facts unavailable in the query/evidence.
No arbitrary confidence floats. No current parser output or v1 verdict may be used as evidence.
review_goal: Determine original candidate label pair independently. If definitive original semantics do not serve the intended AMBIGUOUS stratum, propose the smallest wording revision that makes the mandatory author-title mapping choice explicitly unresolved while retaining the scope, meaningful constraints and intended testing objective. Preserve original queries and label lineage. A different fresh reviewer must judge any proposed revisions before acceptance.
revision_requirements: At most five rows; no new core-family generation.
Keep stable original IDs with explicit context_version and parent fingerprints.
Revise only text needed to specify the ambiguity; avoid decorative padding.
